title: Open Fire
subtitle: Shooting phase: pick a shooter, aim your guns, roll the dice
subtitle_orky: Shooting phase: pick a shooter, aim yer guns, roll da dice

bullets: Click a unit (board or list) to make it the shooter, then point each gun at something.
Pick a gun in the weapon list, then click the enemy — that gun is now aimed. [b]All → <enemy>[/b] does every gun left in one go.
In a real game, if only ONE enemy is in range and sight, the guns aim themselves — we switched that off here so you get the practice.
[b]Confirm (N weapons)[/b] locks the targets in and opens the dice dock.
Guns fire top-to-bottom down the dock queue — [b]▲[/b] / [b]▼[/b] on the right of each row re-orders them before the first shot.
Each gun rolls to hit, then to wound, then the defender saves — kills from one gun are gone before the next fires.
[b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls everything; [b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] goes step by step. [b]Done[/b] closes each save card.
[b]Complete Shooting[/b] finishes the unit — then pick the next shooter or end the phase.
The [b]Dice Log[/b] tab on the left panel keeps every roll — check it when a result looks off.
[b]Shoot All Remaining[/b] auto-fires every unit you haven't aimed yourself.

prompt.text: The Boyz are out of the wagon and the Witchseekers are in slugga range. In the Shooting phase every unit gets one go at firing — let's train your trigger fingers.

prompt.kbm: Click your [b]Boyz[/b] squad — on the board or in the unit list on the right. The weapon list on the right fills up with every gun they have, all saying [b](Click to Select)[/b] — nothing is aimed yet.

prompt.pad: Every gun is pointed — now lock them in: press {menu}, that's [b]Confirm Targets[/b] on the pad. Want to re-aim first? {dpad} ◀▶ walks the targets, ▲▼ walks your guns, {a} aims the current gun.

prompt.kbm:
The declaration panel is gone and the [b]WEAPON RESOLUTION[/b] dock has taken its place on the right. Each row is one gun pointed at one squad, with the damage we expect it to do, and they fire [b]top to bottom[/b] — one gun goes all the way through before the next one starts.
Every gun rolls the same three steps: [b]hit rolls[/b] against its Ballistic Skill, then [b]wound rolls[/b] (your Strength against their Toughness), then the defender makes [b]saving throws[/b] and whatever gets through does damage and takes models off.
[b]The firing order is yours to pick.[/b] The [b]▲[/b] and [b]▼[/b] buttons on the right-hand side of each row move that gun up or down the queue — only while it's still waiting, so sort it now. It matters: boys killed by the first gun aren't there to soak up the second.
When you're happy: [b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls everything at once, or [b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] walks it step by step. Enemy saves pop up a results card — click [b]Done[/b] on each. When the big button says [b]Complete Shooting[/b], click it to finish the squad's turn.

done.script:
var glp = tree.root.get_node_or_null("/root/Main/GameLogPanel")
return glp != null and str(glp.get_active_tab()) == "dice"

hint.text: The tab is at the top of the left panel, next to [b]Game Log[/b] — it's wearing a ● because there are rolls you haven't read yet.

steps.comment: This lived in T1 (Scoutin' da Field) between the datasheet steps, where it asked the player to open the Dice Log before anything had been rolled — an empty panel. It sits here instead: 'roll_da_dice' above it only completes once U_BOYZ_T.flags.has_shot is true, so by the time this step is up the shooting phase has written its hit/wound/save blocks into the shared dice log (see tests/scenarios/sp/dice_log_left_tab_shooting.json) and the tab is carrying its unread ● nudge.
